LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_Night_Text: The evening at {HOME} is running on past midnight: {COUNT} of the colony are still up, and nobody wants to go to bed.
LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_Saw_Night: {WHO} saw the evening at {HOME} run on past midnight, everyone staying up when they meant to go to bed.
LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_Sight_Ore: a seam of {ORE} in the rock {DIR}
LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_Sight_Buried: something buried {DIR}, waiting to be dug up
LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_Vision_TextTrue: {PAWN} stopped and stared, high, then walked out to what they had seen: {SIGHT}. It was there.
LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_Vision_TextFalse: {PAWN} stopped and stared, high, then walked out to where they saw {SIGHT}, and stood there a long while. Nobody else can see anything there.
LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_Saw_Vision: {WHO} had a vision at {HOME} and walked out to it: {SIGHT}.
LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_Craving_Text: In the small hours {PAWN} woke wanting it, got up and went to the stores for {DRUG}.
LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_Saw_Craving: {WHO} saw {PAWN} get up in the night at {HOME} and go to the stores for {DRUG}.
LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_Stash_Text: Far out on the land {PAWN} came on {WHAT} hidden at {PAWN_possessive} feet, and nobody knows who left it there.
LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_Saw_Stash: {WHO} found {WHAT} hidden far out on the land at {HOME}, left there by nobody they knew of.
LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_Binge_Text: {PAWN}, deep in the binge, is talking and laughing with an empty seat as if someone were pouring for them.
LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_Saw_Binge: {WHO} saw {PAWN} at {HOME}, deep in a binge, talking and laughing with an empty seat.
LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_LetGo_Begin: {SITTER} has gone to sit up the night with {PAWN}, who is fighting a craving.
LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_LetGo_Text: {SITTER} sat up all night with {PAWN} through the worst of the craving, and by morning it had eased: the hold of {DRUG} on them is weaker.
LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_Saw_LetGo: {WHO} sat up all night at {HOME} with {PAWN} through a craving, and by morning it had eased.
LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_Believes_LetGo: In the night the craving let go of me, and it wasn't my own doing.
LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_Satyr_Text: A tall man with goat's horns walked in out of the dark at {HOME}, laughing, with a cup of {DRINK} in his hand, and made straight for the people still up.
LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_Satyr_Share: The horned reveller put his cup of {DRINK} into {PAWN}'s hands, and {PAWN} drank it.
LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_Saw_Shared: {WHO} was handed a cup by a man with goat's horns at {HOME}, and drank it.
LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_Saw_Satyr: {WHO} saw a man with goat's horns walk in out of the dark at {HOME} with a cup in his hand.
LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_Satyr_Gone: The horned reveller is gone from {HOME}, and nobody saw him leave.
LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_Cup_Clean: {PAWN} took a {DRUG} and has a high better than any they remember, with a clear head.
LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_Cup_Sharp: After a {DRUG}, {PAWN}'s mind is quick and clear, and their hands quicker.
LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_Cup_Bold: After a {DRUG}, {PAWN} is afraid of nothing, and pain hardly reaches them.
LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_Cup_High: {PAWN} took a {DRUG} and feels better than they have in years.
LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_Cup_CrashCame: {PAWN}'s high has turned, all at once, into a hard crash.
LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_Cup_Craving: {PAWN} finished a {DRUG} and wants another, badly.
LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_Cup_Hooked: {PAWN} took one {DRUG}, and already it has a hold on them: they are addicted to {CHEMICAL}.
LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_Believes_Cup_Blessed: The {DRUG} I took on {DATE} was blessed, and I was given something with it.
LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_Believes_Cup_Strong: There was something more than drink in the {DRUG} I took on {DATE}.
LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_Believes_Cup_Shown: The {DRUG} I took on {DATE} showed me what is really there.
LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_Believes_Cup_Tricked: The {DRUG} I took on {DATE} was a trick played on me.
LanguageData.CC_GodRevel_Believes_Cup_Cursed: The {DRUG} I took on {DATE} was cursed.
